scope: Only the new owner finite engines, wrappers, artifact generators and evidence records.

reviewed_topics.observation: Closed required keys and finite integer/list limits are checked before policy arithmetic.
Jobs are bounded to eight, service to one hundred, other lists to thirty-two, DRR rounds to one hundred and total retained packets to thirty-two.
The two finite engines contain no network, filesystem-write, subprocess, random or wall-clock operations. CLI wrappers print one result envelope.
Weighted finish tags compare BigInt cross-products and allocation ratios are reduced fractions; declared logical ticks do not imply physical measurement.
Synthetic comparison, missing evaluation and consequential allocation retain represented, open_gap and exact_gate outcomes.
The UI inserts request/result text with textContent and uses local inline runtime assets. No externally loaded images or scripts are used.

Synthetic labels, source hashes, public owner labels and generic evidence boundaries are retained. Raw task identifiers, credentials, app streams and screenshots are excluded. The installed-validator path in the local workflow helper is runtime configuration, outside public ledger routing fields.

runtime_portability.portable_reuse_requires: Select the installed Skill Creator validator path for the new host.
